mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary regime that raises real interest rates, reducing present value of future corporate earnings and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 of more than 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not significantly below zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in UNRATE above 6% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and input costs, compressing profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not significantly different from zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO of more than 0.5% for three consecutive months signals weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous month and < previous month - 0.5% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not significantly below zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in HOUST and a fall in GDPC1 over the same month indicates divergent housing and aggregate demand signals, which increases uncertainty and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > previous month and GDPC1 < previous month within the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not significantly different from zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in FEDFUNDS and a decrease in CPIAUCSL over two months signals a restrictive monetary policy that is effective in reducing inflation, which supports equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > previous month and CPIAUCSL < previous month for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not significantly above zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in PAYEMS above trend by more than 0.5% month-over-month for four consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > trend + 0.5% for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not significantly above zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on positive correlation between RSAFS and GDPC1 over rolling 12-month periods signals synchronized growth in household savings and GDP, which supports stable consumption and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between RSAFS and GDPC1 is not significantly positive at 5% significance in more than 30% of rolling 12-month windows, or S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly above zero during periods of high correlation.
